items.title: 3 Reasons to Sell MRK and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Over the past six months, Merck has been a great trade, beating the S&P 500 by 13.4%. Its stock price has climbed to $149.98, representing a healthy 29.6% increase. This was partly thanks to its solid quarterly results, and the performance may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: Moderna Adds Another 5% and Is Up 500% in 2026. Can MRNA Stock Continue the Melt-Up?
items.summary: Moderna has surged over 500% this year while its closest messenger RNA rival sits nearly flat, and a single late-October data presentation at ESMO could either cement the rally or erase it overnight.

items.title: Could You Have Seen Merck Stock's Pipeline Run Coming?
items.summary: Merck (MRK) stock gained about 89% in the year from mid-September 2025, against a 17.1% price gain for the S&P 500. It also beat Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), up 58%, and Eli Lilly (LLY), up 54%. The signs were public long before the run, in what management kept saying about its drug pipeline. The reported sales told a different story.

items.title: Why Is JNJ Stock Beating Rivals That Grow Faster?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) stock has returned 58% over the past twelve months, second best in a group of six health care companies. Its revenue growth ranks only fourth of the six. Three peers grew faster and returned less, Eli Lilly among them. The price is a bet that the rest of the business keeps growing once shrinking STELARA sales stop dragging on the total.

items.title: Wall Street Analysts Think Merck (MRK) Is a Good Investment: Is It?
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for Merck (MRK) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?

items.title: MRNA Hits 52-Week High: How Melanoma Study Results Keep Rally Going
items.summary: Moderna's 52-week high follows positive melanoma results, with detailed phase III data set for an ESMO presentation.

items.title: Why Is Merck (MRK) In Focus After Japan Cleared A New Dosing Option?
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) received Japanese approval for KEYTRUDA QLEX (KEYJECT), its first subcutaneous KEYTRUDA formulation, for all existing local indications. The new subcutaneous version offers an alternative to intravenous dosing, aimed at faster administration for patients and clinicians. This approval broadens Merck's oncology treatment options in Japan, a key international market for its immunotherapy portfolio. The KEYTRUDA QLEX subcutaneous green light in Japan matters. items.title: Moderna (MRNA) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of biotechnology company Moderna (NASDAQ:MRNA) jumped 9.4% in the afternoon session after positive Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial results evaluating its personalized cancer vaccine, intismeran autogene, alongside Merck's Keytruda in high-risk melanoma patients continued to drive momentum.
